summary: Retested the 4 offline-mode fixes from iteration_11 plus a quick regression, frontend only. All 4 fixes PASS. FIX1: after priming caches online, reloading /app/timecards with every /api/** request aborted stays on /app/timecards with no redirect to /login. The timecards-cached label ('Showing saved copy') is visible and the cached employee is listed. FIX2: queued an offline clock-in (status 'On site · pending', banner '(1 pending)'), then ran set_offline(False). The 'Synced 1 offline action' toast appeared without any click, the banner disappeared and ht:queue was []. FIX3: added a photo offline inside job-photos-modal (job-photos-queued shown). After reconnecting with the modal still open, the queued thumbnail turned into a real job-photo (2 -> 3) and the queued label went away. After closing, the Photos column showed 3 (was 1), with no manual reload. FIX4: /app/team offline (after an online visit) listed 38 cached team-row entries. Regression PASS: online clock in/out, online photo upload with caption, the crew modal opens with crew, vehicles and equipment, and logout removes ht:user. Reloading with the API blocked after logout redirects to /login.

integration_issues.issue: Logout removes only ht:user. ht:cache:/jobs, /employees, /timecards, /timecards/active and ht:queue remain in localStorage, so the next user on a shared device can see this company's cached data or sync its queued actions. This was an open action item from iteration_11.

issues: Write controls stay enabled while offline: the Add member button, the role select and the remove buttons. Using them just produces error toasts. The Jobs, Vehicles and Equipment pages hide write actions offline; Team should do the same and show a 'Showing saved copy' label.

action_items: On logout, also remove ht:cache:* and ht:queue (or key them by user/company id)
Team page: hide or disable add-member, member-role-select and member-remove-btn when offline or showing cached data, and show a cached label
critical_code_review_comments: Jobs.js: the reloadKey effect runs on mount (online && pending===0), so CrudManager remounts and fetches /jobs twice on every visit. Skip the first run or bump the key only when pending goes from >0 to 0.

JobPhotosModal: if the queue flushes while the modal is open, CrudManager remounts and photoJob._reload points at the reload of the unmounted instance. It does no harm right now because the remount refetches anyway, but it is fragile.
AuthContext.refresh: a 401 response does not clear ht:user (it just sets the user to false). That is fine, but removing the key would be cleaner.
enqueue still has no guard against QuotaExceededError for large base64 photos (open from iteration_11).
GET /api/files/{path} company scoping is still open from iteration_11 (backend not retested).
seed_data_creation: Added 2 photos (captions TEST_online, TEST_offline) to the job 'TEST Fmn Job'. Created clock-in/out timecards for Mike Rivera, all closed (he is left 'Off').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Offline reload in preview: page.route('**/api/**', abort) then page.reload() (set_offline blocks HTML because there is no service worker). For SPA navigation while offline, use history.pushState plus a popstate event. Photo upload uses set_input_files on job-photo-file-input with a 1x1 png buffer.
